model.status: Requested through the authorized ChatGPT subscription CLI in the first Reactor Lab development pilot.

limits.note: Initial generous development ceilings, not calibrated main-run limits. Stop on completion. Record official 1000-step and extended 2000-step outcomes separately. No aggregate reported-token cutoff; record input/output/cached tokens. Preserve intrinsic model context limits.

failure_policy: Keep every initial attempt. Completed replies with malformed arguments return their error to the model within the original call budget; service failures stop.
resume_policy: New output directory required; interrupted attempts remain preserved.

outcomes.primary: Environment completedSuccessfully at the fixed action limits, macro averaged by theme and difficulty.
secondary: successful experiments and revised hypotheses in actual action traces
model calls, tokens including cached input, elapsed/model/Python time
service, timeout, invalid action, budget exhaustion and scientific failure categories
outcomes.knowledge_score: Official free-text explanatory-knowledge score requires a judge. Do not substitute success/procedural score for it; no knowledge-accuracy claim until a judging protocol is specified.

fairness: Both agents receive the same public text observations/actions and initial files. Ordinary Code can store and execute its own research programs. Gold rules, hidden scorecards and scenario source are evaluation-side materials.
prefix_cost_scope: Prefix costs combine prior continuations and the source checkpoint; environment steps are cumulative, not added twice. Python/wall costs are known subtotals if an ancestral call-cut prefix lacked those costs.
purpose: Test model-authored repair of existing analyses on the same paid evidence, then parent continuation. This is an operator-assigned review, not autonomous error detection or a full-task performance comparison.
replay_policy: Each arm replays the frozen official actions and compares public success/messages before model calls, using the existing continuation runner.
accounting: New model calls and tokens start at zero. The environment ceiling includes the prefix; prior costs and new environment steps are reported separately.

definitions.applicability: An operator-authored public-menu procedure for a caller-selected reference and reversible menu controls. Its archive records one actual execution; the caller must interpret physical outcomes and transfer conditions.

supplied_methods.scope: Same operator-supplied programs and separate public practice for both arms; no local answers supplied.

operator_assignment.text:
# Operator-assigned review of existing child analyses

Before acquiring further observations, re-examine the two existing child
analyses below against their already paid records. This review was requested by
the operator; discovering the need for this review is not part of this trial.
No scientific answer or frequency law is supplied.

1. `test_crystal4_870`: inspect the frozen selected 916-Hz experiment and its
   observations 390 through 400. Its identifier and some inherited wording refer
   to 870 Hz; interpret the selected experiment actually executed. The repeat
   attempt at 401 is a separate attempt, not the start of the preceding trial.
2. `intervention_34810`: inspect the empty-setting/insertion trial at observations
   370 through 380 and its frozen prediction. Distinguish this trial from the
   earlier 363 through 369 trial and the later unsuccessful repeat. Do not let
   the latest invocation boundary erase evidence from the completed trial.

Read the actual records and the current analysis source. Compare their field
paths, object descriptions and UUID references, intended conditions, achieved
controls and physical outcomes. A missing observation and an observed negative
outcome have different meanings. Interpret the evidence yourself; an outcome
may support, refute or leave the specified prediction unresolved. State only the
scope established by these records, and cite their observation indices.

Repair each analysis through the existing `evaluate` action with its own
`question_id`, a separate analysis `path`, and inline `code` defining
`answer(public_spec, observations, memory)`. Do not run `contrast` or acquire
another observation merely to repair analysis of an existing trial. Preserve
the original experiment design and procedure source. Inspect the actual
evaluation result; repair remaining analysis errors on the same paid evidence.

After both child analyses are resolved as far as the existing evidence allows,
return to the parent research and let their scoped answers inform the next
scientific decision. Further experiments are then available if justified.
